claim_boundary: The 1,100-run catalog is a bounded exhaustive oracle over the frozen 22-candidate matrix, not a global CKKS optimum. Direct/catalog timings were recorded in separate processes and remain UNPAIRED_DIAGNOSTIC. The planner is a candidate provider and its full MLP optimum recall is 36%, so it is not supported as a fastest-SAFE oracle substitute.

direct_summary.claim_boundary: The fixed catalog is a bounded oracle. Latencies in this comparison were recorded in separate processes and are diagnostic only. A paired repeated protocol is required before any paper speedup or latency-regret claim.

metric_semantics.false_no_safe: true only when SAFE_oracle is non-empty and SAFE_planner is empty
metric_semantics.optimum_recall: 1 when the exhaustive fastest-SAFE candidate is in C_planner, 0 otherwise; blank when SAFE_oracle is empty
metric_semantics.oracle_no_safe: safe/optimum recall and regret are undefined, not zero
metric_semantics.safe_recall: |SAFE_oracle intersect C_planner| / |SAFE_oracle|; blank when SAFE_oracle is empty
